comment_symbols: List of asset symbols to monitor for funding rate opportunities. Symbols not available on both Hyperliquid and Pacifica will be automatically filtered out and ignored.
comment_leverage: Target leverage for positions on both exchanges. Will be automatically reduced if it exceeds the maximum allowed leverage on either exchange or the hard cap of 20x. The bot will use the minimum of: configured value, Hyperliquid max, Pacifica max, and 20x hard cap.
comment_base_capital: BASE CAPITAL allocation in USD (not leveraged position size). The actual position size will be: base_capital_allocation × leverage. Example: $100 base with 3x leverage = $300 position on each exchange. The bot automatically applies a 2% safety buffer and will further reduce if insufficient margin is available.
comment_hold_duration: The number of hours to hold a position to collect funding.
_comment_hold_duration_hours: RAISED 8.0 -> 72.0. Break-even APR = roundtrip_fee_pct * (8760/hold_hours). Verified round trip for HL+Pacifica is 0.170% (HL taker 0.045% + Pacifica taker 0.040%, both legs, entry and exit). At an 8h hold that is a 186% break-even, which is why this bot recorded 11 'successful' cycles totalling -$4.46. At 72h it drops to 20.7%. Raising the threshold alone could not fix this: no pair sustains the ~372% needed for a 2x margin at 8h.
comment_wait_between: The number of minutes to wait after closing a position before searching for a new one. Also after stoploss.
comment_check_interval: The number of seconds between health checks when holding a position (including stoploss check).
comment_min_apr: The minimum net APR required to open a position. (e.g., 5.0 means 5%)
_comment_min_net_apr_threshold: RAISED 5.0 -> 45.0. This is a GROSS funding-spread threshold; it must clear the 20.7% break-even at the new 72h hold with roughly a 2x safety margin. 5.0 accepted trades that lost money on essentially every cycle.
